description: Source code for RTSP streaming in Android's NuPlayer, implementing RTSP client logic including connection management, data buffering, seeking, and message handling.

classes.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource
classes.description: Class managing RTSP streaming, connection, buffering, seeking, and message handling within Android's NuPlayer.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the RTSP connection and message loop.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::stop
methods.description: Stops the RTSP connection and message loop.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::feedMoreTSData
methods.description: Returns the final result status, indicating if more data can be fed.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::getFormat
methods.description: Retrieves media format information for audio or video tracks.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::haveSufficientDataOnAllTracks
methods.description: Checks if buffered data on all tracks is sufficient for playback.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::dequeueAccessUnit
methods.description: Dequeues the next access unit (frame) for audio or video.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::getSource
methods.description: Returns the packet source for audio or video.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::getDuration
methods.description: Calculates total media duration based on track data.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::seekTo
methods.description: Performs a seek operation to a specified timestamp.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages for connection, data, and control events.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::onConnected
methods.description: Initializes media tracks upon successful connection.

methods.name: NuPlayer::RTSPSource::finishDisconnectIfPossible
methods.description: Completes disconnection process if conditions are met.
